title: [AUG-92] Implement "Sage & Parchment" light theme
why_we_need_this: The current light theme has muddy gray-green backgrounds with almost no contrast between surfaces, a near-black sidebar that clashes with the light content area, and hardcoded dark-mode rgba values throughout components. The brainstorm (AUG-89) selected the "Sage & Parchment" direction: light sage sidebar from direction #7 + warm parchment main from direction #5.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Update `:root` CSS variables in `@client/src/App.css` to the Sage & Parchment palette:
   - --page-bg: #f2efe8
   - --main-bg: #f2efe8
   - --sidebar-bg: #c8dcd0
   - --sidebar-bg-hover: #bdd4c8
   - --sidebar-bg-active: #b0ccbe
   - --sidebar-text: #1a3326
   - --sidebar-text-muted: #4a7a60
   - --sidebar-border: #a8c4b4
   - --accent: #0d8c5c
   - --accent-hover: #0a7a50
   - --accent-light: rgba(13,140,92,0.12)
   - --accent-glow: rgba(13,140,92,0.18)
   - --text-primary: #2d3a33
   - --text-secondary: #6b7a70
   - --border-color: rgba(45,58,51,0.18)
   - --card-bg: rgba(250,248,244,0.92)
   - --circuit-node-bg: #f0ede6
   - --card-border: rgba(45,58,51,0.14)
   - --card-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(45,58,51,0.08)
   - --shell-gradient: update to warm parchment tones
   - --shell-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(45,58,51,0.08)
2. Fix all hardcoded rgba(0,200,118,...) values in light-mode component styles (search input, filter chips, scrollbars, chip rays) — replace with values appropriate for the sage sidebar or use CSS variables
3. Fix the `.upload-panel h2` color (currently uses --necron-50 which is wrong for light sidebar)
4. Dark theme (:root[data-theme='dark']) must remain completely unchanged
5. Visual verification: sidebar is light sage, main content is warm parchment, cards are off-white cream, clear hierarchy between all three surface levels
6. No border-radius changes (must stay 0 per project brandbook)
important_constraints:
- Do NOT touch :root[data-theme='dark'] block — dark theme is not part of this task
- All border-radius values must remain 0
- The sidebar search input, filter chips, and scrollbar styles have hardcoded dark-background colors that MUST be updated for the light sage sidebar
- Test both themes after changes to confirm dark mode is unaffected
